summary: Google does not let you turn AI Overviews off. The closest thing to an opt-out is routing around it: the Web filter tab, the udm=14 trick, or a different search engine.

steps.path: Run your search → below the search bar pick the "Web" tab (sometimes hidden under "More"). Results-page-only, resets on every new search.
Force web-only results by appending Google's undocumented udm=14 parameter, or set a custom search engine in your browser that does it for you.
Switch default search engine. DuckDuckGo lets you toggle AI answers on and off before searching.

collateral: the Web tab has to be re-selected for every search
udm=14 is undocumented and can be removed by Google at any time
regionNotes: Rollout and available filter tabs differ by country; the absence of an off switch does not.
whyTheyDidIt: AI Overviews keep the answer on Google's page instead of sending the click to the site that wrote it — the whole point is that you cannot leave.

sources.label: Consumer Reports — how to turn off AI tools (Gemini, Apple Intelligence, Copilot)

alternatives.name: DuckDuckGo
alternatives.why: AI answers are a toggle you control, not a default

alternatives.name: Kagi
alternatives.why: paid search, AI is opt-in per query
